summary: M.S. Computer Engineering candidate at Rochester Institute of Technology (May 2026). Built an end-to-end embodied AI system integrating TensorRT visual servoing (18 FPS), multimodal intent classification, and contact-aware manipulation on a physical robot arm — 100% pick reliability across 10 trials. Experienced with ROS2, real-robot control (UR5e, AL5B), simulation (CARLA), and LeRobot-structured data collection pipelines for visuomotor policy training.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end-to-end.
Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) on a custom dataset; improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via preprocessing and model tuning.
Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch to standardize training and evaluation workflows.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi Pico over Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands — an IMU-driven embodied control interface.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built end-to-end embodied AI pipeline: voice → TensorRT YOLO visual servoing (18 FPS) → Gemini intent classification (<500ms) → contact-aware pick-and-place; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).
Constructed LeRobot-structured multi-camera data collection pipeline for visuomotor policy training; implemented two-link IK in C++ with contact-aware ToF grasping.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Planned and executed collision-free pick-and-place trajectories on physical UR5e via UR ROS2 driver; AL5B repeatability measured at <2mm over 10 trials.
Derived DH tables and forward kinematic chains (0T6) for 6-DoF UR5e and 5-DoF AL5B; validated against MoveIt and RViz URDF models.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built sim-to-real data pipelines in CARLA (semantic segmentation + raycast filtering) producing ~5,000 YOLO / ~3,000 UFLD frames; zero manual annotation.
Trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18); validated zero-collision laps in Town02 with 30 vehicles and 10 pedestrians.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Closed the perception-to-actuation loop on physical hardware: YOLOv8 on Jetson → UART → STM32 PWM multi-servo control with FreeRTOS task coordination and VL53L0X range-gating.

awards: Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
